title: Herbaceous Grassy Indian Paneer Tikka
description: A keto-friendly Indian dish featuring paneer tikka with a grassy and crunchy texture, infused with the richness of black treacle, and served in a unique lazy-susan-spinner vessel using a bain-marie cooking method.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit using a bain-marie cooking method to ensure even heating.
In a large bowl, whisk together ghee, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, and salt.
Add the paneer cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated paneer cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
While the paneer is baking, mix together black treacle, chopped cilantro, and chopped mint in a small bowl.
After 15 minutes, brush the black treacle mixture evenly onto the paneer cubes.
Return the paneer to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cubes are lightly browned.
Remove the paneer from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the herbaceous grassy Indian paneer tikka in a lazy-susan-spinner vessel, garnished with additional cilantro and mint if desired.
